manifest.claim_text: The electromagnetic solver reproduces a closed-form quasi-static reference, validated independently of any neural-response model.

manifest.consequence_if_failed: The EM solver may not be used for lead fields, E-field prediction or targeting; every downstream field-dependent claim is suspended.
non_goals: These checks establish code correctness only. Numerical correctness is necessary, never sufficient: agreement with recorded signals is stronger, held-out perturbation stronger still (thesis §0.2).
